channel.title: Sunshine Coast — this week's events
channel.description: Events in Sunshine Coast for the week of 2026-09-07 to 2026-09-13, ranked by fit.

item.title: Vibecamp 2026
item.description:
Fri 11 Sep, 5:00 PM · Habitat Noosa Everglades Eco Camp · Ticketed
A multi-day intellectual and social gathering designed for curious people to share ideas, host discussions, and participate in community-driven workshops in an outdoor, relaxed setting. The event focuses on fostering authentic connections between intellectually engaged attendees.

item.title: Wildflowering walk and draw at Kathleen McArthur Conservation Park
item.description:
12 September 2026, 9:00 AM · Kathleen McArthur Conservation Park, Wurtulla · Free
A guided outdoor session combining a nature walk through the conservation park with an informal drawing workshop. Designed for observers and creatives to document local flora in a quiet, natural setting.

item.title: AI Explained – Understand the Basics of Artificial Intelligence
item.description:
18 Aug–16 Sep 2026 · Sunshine Coast Libraries (various branches) · Free
A series of information sessions demystifying AI technology, how it works, and its role in modern society, designed for the curious general public.

item.title: Psychologically‑Informed Creative Wellbeing Experience
item.description:
Sat 29 Aug 2026, 01:00 PM · Cooroy Butter Factory Arts Centre, Cooroy · $160
A 4-week series integrating psychological principles with creative practice to promote personal wellbeing and self-reflection in a group setting.

item.title: Big Love Festival
item.description:
11 September 2026 · Eudlo · Ticketed
A community-focused boutique music and arts festival set in the hinterland, emphasizing intimate performances, workshops, and a collaborative, creative atmosphere.

item.title: Propagating Native Plants for Your Backyard
item.description:
Sat 12 Sep, 10:00 AM · Maroochy Regional Bushland Botanic Garden, Tanawha · Ticketed
A hands-on workshop focused on the techniques required to propagate local native plant species, held at the dedicated Arts & Ecology Centre. Participants will learn practical botanical skills suitable for home gardening and environmental conservation.

item.title: Bloom — Exhibition
item.description:
Sat 29 Aug, 10:00 AM · The Little Red Cottage, Maleny · Free
A recurring exhibition exploring the intersection of local ecology and art through the lens of wildflowers. Ideal for those interested in botany, local environment, and creative displays.

item.title: AI A-Team Builder Workshop
item.description:
Fri 11 Sep, 9:00 AM · Sunrise Beach · $150
A hands-on workshop focused on practical AI integration for small teams and creative projects, emphasizing workflow design and efficiency.

item.title: Silent Film - The Great Train Robbery & other shorts
item.description:
12 September 2026, TBD · Majestic Theatre, 3 Factory Street, Pomona · Not stated
A screening of classic silent films at a historic theatre, offering an immersive look into the origins of cinema history.

item.title: THE BIG Beach Clean Up
item.description:
Sat 12 Sep, 8:00 AM · Clark Place Park, Caloundra · Free
A community-driven environmental initiative where volunteers gather to remove coastal debris, fostering connection and environmental stewardship.

item.title: Expressive drawing masterclass
item.description:

A hands-on workshop designed to help participants explore expressive drawing techniques in a structured, creative environment at the regional gallery.

A curated exhibition showcasing contemporary ceramic works from members of The Australian Ceramics Association, highlighting diverse techniques and artistic approaches.

item.title: Sunshine Coast National Art Prize 2026 Finalists Exhibition
item.description:
21 Aug – 11 Oct 2026, gallery open regular hours · Caloundra Regional Gallery, Felicity House, Caloundra · Free
A high-profile exhibition showcasing the finalists of the prestigious National Art Prize, featuring diverse contemporary works from artists across Australia. It serves as a great space for quiet contemplation and observing current trends in the visual arts.

A pop-up artisan display featuring ceramic works by Catherine Dinkelmann, exploring themes of belonging and craftsmanship.

24 August 2026 - 30 August 2026 · Caloundra Regional Gallery · Free
An exhibition showcasing the finalists of a national art prize, featuring diverse contemporary works from across Australia. This provides an opportunity to engage with high-caliber visual art in a focused gallery setting.

A structured salsa class for beginners and intermediates focusing on rhythm, technique, and social dancing skills in a relaxed environment.
